```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

The blood counts of the SHCS database are interpolated for each person and parameter with a smoothing spline
(`smooth.spline()`, `spar` = 0.5) and predicted every half year. They are joined to the half-year grid of the REML curves
of the CHIP trajectories and to the age at the start of antiretroviral therapy (first ART drug in `med_drug.csv`). The
table `resources/SHCS_CHIP_blood_trajectories_merged.txt` is the input of the blood-parameter models
(`6_figures_and_tables/Figure3_FiguresS9_S10.Rmd`, Figure 3, Figures S9 and S10, Table S9).

```{r parameters}
# half-year grid of the REML curves (2_trajectory_models/01_spline_fits.Rmd)
curves_file <- "resources/LoD/SHCS_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt"
db_dir <- "resources/SHCS_database/2025-09/"
counts_cols <- c("LEU", "HEM", "PLA", "LYM", "CD3", "CD3P", "CD4", "CD4P", "CD8", "CD8P", "CD4_CD8_ratio", "RNA")
```

# Data

```{r data}
predicted_trajectories <- read.table(curves_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

lab <- read.csv(file.path(db_dir, "lab.csv")) %>%
  filter(ID %in% predicted_trajectories$ID) %>%
  select(ID, LABDATE, LEU, HEM, PLA, LYM, LYMP, CD3, CD3P, CD4, CD4P, CD8, CD8P, RNA, CENTER)

pat <- read.csv(file.path(db_dir, "pat.csv")) %>%
  filter(ID %in% predicted_trajectories$ID)

lab <- lab %>%
  merge(pat %>% select(ID, BORN), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(Age = as.numeric(as.Date(LABDATE) - as.Date(paste0(BORN, "-01-01"))) / 365.25) %>%
  select(-BORN) %>%
  mutate(CD4_CD8_ratio = (CD4 + 1) / (CD8 + 1))

summary(lab %>% select(-ID, -LABDATE, -CENTER))
```

# Interpolation of the blood counts

A parameter needs more than three measurements in a person; the prediction runs from the first to the last
measurement (ages rounded to whole years) in steps of half a year, and negative predictions are set to 0.

```{r interpolate}
ids <- unique(lab$ID)
predicted_lab <- c()

for (i in seq_along(ids)) {
  one_id <- ids[i]
  one_id_pred_traj <- c()

  for (col in counts_cols) {
    one_traj <- lab %>% filter(ID == one_id) %>%
      select(ID, LABDATE, Age, all_of(col)) %>%
      mutate(data_point = 1) %>% arrange(Age) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[col]]))

    if (nrow(one_traj) > 3) {
      new_age <- seq(round(min(one_traj$Age)), round(max(one_traj$Age)), 0.5)
      af_spl <- smooth.spline(x = one_traj$Age, y = one_traj[[col]], spar = 0.5)
      y <- predict(af_spl, x = new_age)$y
      y[y < 0] <- 0
      df_pred_one_traj <- data.frame(ID = one_id, Age = new_age)
      df_pred_one_traj[[col]] <- y
    } else {
      df_pred_one_traj <- data.frame(ID = one_id, Age = NA_real_)
      df_pred_one_traj[[col]] <- NA_real_
    }

    # one row per person and age: the parameters are joined by age only
    if (is.null(one_id_pred_traj)) {
      one_id_pred_traj <- df_pred_one_traj
    } else {
      one_id_pred_traj <- merge(one_id_pred_traj, df_pred_one_traj, by = c("ID", "Age"), all = TRUE)
    }
  }
  predicted_lab <- rbind(predicted_lab, one_id_pred_traj %>% filter(!is.na(Age)))
}
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(predicted_lab[c("ID", "Age")]))

tibble(parameter = counts_cols,
       `persons with an interpolated curve` = map_int(counts_cols, ~ n_distinct(predicted_lab$ID[!is.na(predicted_lab[[.x]])]))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Start of antiretroviral therapy

```{r art-start}
med_drug <- read.csv(file.path(db_dir, "med_drug.csv"))

art_start <- med_drug %>%
  filter(INDICATION == "A") %>%
  filter(ID %in% predicted_trajectories$ID) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice(which.min(as.Date(STARTDATE))) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, STARTDATE) %>%
  merge(pat %>% select(ID, BORN), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(AgeArtStart = as.numeric(as.Date(STARTDATE) - as.Date(paste0(BORN, "-01-01"))) / 365.25) %>%
  select(-BORN)

rm(med_drug)
```

# Merge with the curves

Each age of a curve gets the interpolated blood counts at the same age of the person (the curves and the blood counts
are both on a half-year grid of whole and half years of age); the ages of a curve at which the person has no
interpolated blood count are left out.

```{r merge}
traj <- predicted_trajectories %>%
  inner_join(predicted_lab, by = c("ID", "Age")) %>%
  inner_join(art_start, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(TimeSinceArtStart = round(Age - AgeArtStart, digits = 2))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(traj[c("traj_id", "Age")]))

cat(n_distinct(traj$ID), "persons,", n_distinct(traj$traj_id), "trajectories,", nrow(traj), "rows\n")

write.table(traj, "resources/SHCS_CHIP_blood_trajectories_merged.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
